2014_spells.mordenkainen-s-private-sanct: Teleport up to 120 ft to a space you can see

Using 10 minutes, when you cast the spell, you decide what sort of security the spell provides, choosing any or all of the following options: • Sound can't pass through the barrier of the area's perimeter. The area is a cube that can be as small as 5 feet to as large as 100 feet on each side; You make an area within range magically secure. The spell lasts for the duration or until you use an action to dismiss it.
